basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old guy from Little Rock, Arkansas. I've been in a long-term relationship but recently feeling the itch to explore a bit more, especially online. By day, I'm a probation officer, which is a job that keeps me on my toes. I'm a huge fan of Skyrim and spend a lot of my free time modding and playing it. I also have a soft spot for Devin Townsend's music. Late nights are usually when I'm most active on Reddit, especially after my partner goes to bed. I enjoy discussing game strategies, exploring NSFW topics, and diving into the nuances of puberty education. I'm not too fussed about sticking strictly to the rules, as long as I don't get banned. My relationship status is 'it's complicated', and I'm always on the lookout for new experiences.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in criminal justice, which led me to my current job as a probation officer. My love for gaming, especially Skyrim, is self-taught and heavily influenced by online communities and forums. I also keep up with puberty education topics, mostly out of curiosity and a desire to understand human development better.
